"""Native validation selects continuation checkpoints before diagnostics; no promotion."""
import hashlib,json,math,os,re,shutil,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
plan=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/canonical-continuation-plan-2026-09-17.json').read_text())
log=Path('.build/canonical-continuation-training.log').read_text()
assert 'Saved final weights' in log and 'Test loss ' in log
for name,digest in plan['inputs'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
for name,digest in plan['runtimeSourceSHA256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
losses={int(step):float(loss) for step,loss in re.findall(r'Iter (\d+): Val loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log) if int(step)%200==0}
assert sorted(losses)==list(range(200,1201,200)) and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in losses.values())
record=dict(status='Development experiment; no promotion or release holdout query.',plan=plan,
    trainingLog=log,loggedValidationLosses=losses,finalStepTestLoss=float(re.search(r'Test loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log)[1]),
    probeSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),validation={})
output=Path('Training/experiments/canonical-continuation-2026-09-17.json')
assert not output.exists()
for name,digest in plan['retainedFilesSHA256'].items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
def retain():output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
def verify():
    for identities in [plan['inputs'],plan['runtimeSourceSHA256'],plan['retainedFilesSHA256']]:
        for name,digest in identities.items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
def evaluate(label,model,extra):
    verify()
    directory=Path('.build/canonical-continuation-'+label)
    with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',
            plan['runner'],'--model',str(model),
            '--output-directory',str(directory),*extra],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    verify()
    return {**{n:json.loads((directory/(n+'.json')).read_text()) for n in ['report','evidence','failures']},
            'predictions':[json.loads(l) for l in (directory/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
            'nativeResources':(directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()}
models={}
for step in sorted(losses):
    model=Path(f'Models/Artifacts/canonical-continuation-qwen-step{step}')
    models[step]=model
    weights=Path(f'.build/canonical-continuation-adapters/{step:07d}_adapters.safetensors')
    if not model.exists():
        model.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(['/bin/cp','-cR',plan['base'],str(model/'base')],check=True)
        (model/'adapters').mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(weights,model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors')
        shutil.copyfile('.build/canonical-continuation-adapters/adapter_config.json',model/'adapters/adapter_config.json')
    for source in Path(plan['base']).rglob('*'):
        if source.is_file():
            assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256((model/'base'/source.relative_to(plan['base'])).read_bytes()).digest()
    assert weights.read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors').read_bytes()
    assert Path('.build/canonical-continuation-adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()
    record['validation'][step]=evaluate(f'{step}-validation',model,['--gold','Training/experiments/canonical-copy-inputs/validation-gold.jsonl'])
    retain()
    print(step,{k:record['validation'][step]['report'][k] for k in ['editPlanExact','meaningPreservation','contextFit']},flush=True)
allowed=[]
for step,run in record['validation'].items():
    report=run['report']
    for field,count in [('meaningPreservation',32),('contextFit',32),('editPlanExact',32),('adversarialSafe',11),('runtimeConsistency',43)]:
        assert report[field]['applicable']==count
    if all(report[field]['passed']==report[field]['applicable'] for field in ['adversarialSafe','runtimeConsistency']):allowed.append(step)
assert allowed,'No checkpoint passes native safety/runtime checks'
selected=max(allowed,key=lambda step:tuple(record['validation'][step]['report'][k]['passed'] for k in ['meaningPreservation','contextFit','editPlanExact'])+(-losses[step],-step))
record['selectedStep']=selected
record['selectedModel']=str(models[selected])
retain()
print('Selected before development:',selected,flush=True)
for name in ['spelling','position','physical','novel','canonical']:
    record['diagnostic'+name.title()]=evaluate('selected-diagnostic-'+name,models[selected],['--gold','Training/experiments/canonical-copy-inputs/diagnostic-'+name+'.jsonl'])
    retain()
record['development']=evaluate('selected-development',models[selected],[])
retain()
print('development',record['development']['report']['editPlanExact'],flush=True)

record['selectedTrainingFit']=evaluate('selected-training-fit',models[selected],['--gold','Training/experiments/canonical-training-fit-inputs-2026-09-17.jsonl'])
record['status']='Completed fixed continuation experiment; no automatic promotion or frozen release query.'
retain()
print('Finished all predeclared evaluations; no automatic promotion.',flush=True)

"""Native validation selects continuation checkpoints before diagnostics; no promotion."""
import hashlib,json,math,os,re,shutil,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
plan=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/canonical-continuation-plan-2026-09-17.json').read_text())
log=Path('.build/canonical-continuation-training.log').read_text()
assert 'Saved final weights' in log and 'Test loss ' in log
for name,digest in plan['inputs'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
for name,digest in plan['runtimeSourceSHA256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
losses={int(step):float(loss) for step,loss in re.findall(r'Iter (\d+): Val loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log) if int(step)%200==0}
assert sorted(losses)==list(range(200,1201,200)) and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in losses.values())
record=dict(status='Development experiment; no promotion or release holdout query.',plan=plan,
    trainingLog=log,loggedValidationLosses=losses,finalStepTestLoss=float(re.search(r'Test loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log)[1]),
    probeSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),validation={})
output=Path('Training/experiments/canonical-continuation-2026-09-17.json')
assert not output.exists()
for name,digest in plan['retainedFilesSHA256'].items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
def retain():output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
def verify():
    for identities in [plan['inputs'],plan['runtimeSourceSHA256'],plan['retainedFilesSHA256']]:
        for name,digest in identities.items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
def evaluate(label,model,extra):
    verify()
    directory=Path('.build/canonical-continuation-'+label)
    with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',
            plan['runner'],'--model',str(model),
            '--output-directory',str(directory),*extra],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    verify()
    return {**{n:json.loads((directory/(n+'.json')).read_text()) for n in ['report','evidence','failures']},
            'predictions':[json.loads(l) for l in (directory/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
            'nativeResources':(directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()}
models={}
for step in sorted(losses):
    model=Path(f'Models/Artifacts/canonical-continuation-qwen-step{step}')
    models[step]=model
    weights=Path(f'.build/canonical-continuation-adapters/{step:07d}_adapters.safetensors')
    if not model.exists():
        model.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(['/bin/cp','-cR',plan['base'],str(model/'base')],check=True)
        (model/'adapters').mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(weights,model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors')
        shutil.copyfile('.build/canonical-continuation-adapters/adapter_config.json',model/'adapters/adapter_config.json')
    for source in Path(plan['base']).rglob('*'):
        if source.is_file():
            assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256((model/'base'/source.relative_to(plan['base'])).read_bytes()).digest()
    assert weights.read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors').read_bytes()
    assert Path('.build/canonical-continuation-adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()
    record['validation'][step]=evaluate(f'{step}-validation',model,['--gold','Training/experiments/canonical-copy-inputs/validation-gold.jsonl'])
    retain()
    print(step,{k:record['validation'][step]['report'][k] for k in ['editPlanExact','meaningPreservation','contextFit']},flush=True)
allowed=[]
for step,run in record['validation'].items():
    report=run['report']
    for field,count in [('meaningPreservation',32),('contextFit',32),('editPlanExact',32),('adversarialSafe',11),('runtimeConsistency',43)]:
        assert report[field]['applicable']==count
    if all(report[field]['passed']==report[field]['applicable'] for field in ['adversarialSafe','runtimeConsistency']):allowed.append(step)
assert allowed,'No checkpoint passes native safety/runtime checks'
selected=max(allowed,key=lambda step:tuple(record['validation'][step]['report'][k]['passed'] for k in ['meaningPreservation','contextFit','editPlanExact'])+(-losses[step],-step))
record['selectedStep']=selected
record['selectedModel']=str(models[selected])
retain()
print('Selected before development:',selected,flush=True)
for name in ['spelling','position','physical','novel','canonical']:
    record['diagnostic'+name.title()]=evaluate('selected-diagnostic-'+name,models[selected],['--gold','Training/experiments/canonical-copy-inputs/diagnostic-'+name+'.jsonl'])
    retain()
record['development']=evaluate('selected-development',models[selected],[])
retain()
print('development',record['development']['report']['editPlanExact'],flush=True)

record['selectedTrainingFit']=evaluate('selected-training-fit',models[selected],['--gold','Training/experiments/canonical-training-fit-inputs-2026-09-17.jsonl'])
record['status']='Completed fixed continuation experiment; no automatic promotion or frozen release query.'
retain()
print('Finished all predeclared evaluations; no automatic promotion.',flush=True)
